newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser boosts stake in Grupo Modelo.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser boosts stake in Grupo Modelo.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc said it and Grupo Modelo SA de CV have closed their agreement for Anheuser to increase its ownershp of the Mexican brewer and its subsidiaries to 37 percent.
Under the agreement, Anheuser invested an additional $605 milion, bringing its total investment in Grupo Modelo to more than $1.0 billion.
Anheuser had first announced its intention to increase its stake to 37 percent in December. At that time, Anheuser said it would invest about $550 million.

In 1993, Anheuser acquired a 17.7 percent interest in Grupo Modelo and its Diblo SA de CV subsidiary for $477 million. At that time, Anheuser, which brews Budweiser beer, obtained options to increase its investment to 50.2 percent between mid-1995 and the end of 1997.
Anheuser said its board authorized the exercise of the remaining options before the end of the year, but the timing and option exercise price has not been determined.
The investment closed today gives Anheuser additional minority rights. Its number of seats on the Modelo board will rise to 10 from three currently.
The total number of seats on the Modelo board will rise to 21 from 14.
Anheuser said Thursday's agreement was expected to close earlier this year, but was delayed because of continuing discussions over certain purchase price adjustments.
The settlement represents a final agreement on the purchase price adjustments, it added.
Modelo holds more than 57 percent of the Mexican beer market through sales of Corona, Modelo Especial, Pacifico, Negra Modelo and other regional brands. It has eight breweries in Mexico.

"There is great potential in the Mexican beer market," August Busch III, chairman, said in a statement. "Our association with Modelo will help grow that market and enhance our already strong relationship with the Mexican-American community."
Grupo Modelo Chairman Antonio Fernandez said his company plans to expand in Mexico, throughout Latin America and in other parts of the world.
Modelo is the exclusive importer and distributor of Budweiser and other Anheuser brands in Mexico.
Anheuser holds about 45 percent of the U.S. beer market.
